script.speaker: student
script.text: Hello. I tried to register for Saturday's interview workshop, but the website says that the event is full. I wondered whether there is another way to join.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: There is a waiting list. Two extra places became available this morning, although they have not appeared on the website yet. Are you a final-year student?

script.speaker: student
script.text: No, I am in my third year. I am applying for a summer internship, and I have never had a formal interview before.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: That is fine. Final-year students had priority until yesterday, but registration is open to everyone now. I can add your name to one of the new places.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Great. Do I need to bring my internship application or prepare answers in advance?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Bring a printed copy of your CV. During the first hour, the adviser will explain common interview questions. After that, students will practise in pairs and receive comments.

script.speaker: student
script.text: My CV is still a draft. Could someone check it before the workshop?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes. Email it to the career centre by Thursday afternoon. A volunteer will return brief notes on Friday, so you will have time to make changes.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Should I pay online when the new place appears?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The workshop is free. I only need your student number and email address. You will receive a confirmation message later today.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Thank you. I nearly gave up when I saw the full notice.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The online list is sometimes a few hours behind. If your confirmation does not arrive by this evening, call us tomorrow morning.

options.D: To find a paid campus job

options.D: Third-year students do not need to use the website

questions.rationale: Final-year students had priority only until the previous day; registration is now open to everyone.

options.C: Practise interview questions with a partner
